opportunities.title: Small Grant – UK Office
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects; UK office applications must originate from the UK.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring UK and Japan together in arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine, health, science, youth, education, sport, etc.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Award in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year (total up to £30,000 for up to three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; must involve partners in both the UK and Japan; preference for those without prior UK-Japan collaboration and early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
